title: Prove sharp dirty Toeplitz shear gate-cut norm bounds (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with exact finite corroboration. The retained dirty Toeplitz shear's four cut operators have the sharp bound

```text
B = ||g||_1 + ||h||_1
previous envelope: 1+B
sharp envelope:    Phi(B) = (sqrt(B^2+4)+B)/2
```

This is strictly smaller for every B>0 and optimal in every dyadic dimension. It includes prefixes, suffixes, their inverses and cuts after arbitrary subsets of matching-layer gates. The beta-I family attains the bound. Under Jose Manuel's cited stored-unitary and multiplier hypotheses, the same sharpening applies with B=M_g+M_h+2v.

Only `research/fft-dirty-shear-cuts/` is added. The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Jose Manuel for the already dimension-independent additive shear/unitary reduction in the [pinned section-5 proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43/research/rational-unitary-fft/PROOF.md), Vlado Vojdanovski for the compiler, Cinna Davis for its retained Gaussian caller, Brian for the macro-cut/forward-bound continuation, Ryanson Jonathan, unpaidmoon, James Reed and the retained FFT/phase lineage. The elementary block-shear singular-value formula is background. No predecessor executable is imported or replayed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19132751) and [explicit prior-art refinement](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19132834). The latter records that dimension independence already existed; the new result is the optimal constant, not that inherited reduction.

## Evidence

- Before: the retained exact-circuit envelope is 1+B. After: the written gate-cut proof gives Phi(B), with sharpness. At B=3/2 the new constant is exactly 2.
- An independent standard-library checker constructs FFT butterflies, bit reversals, scalar shears and twists exactly over Q(zeta_8). All 756 matching-subset cuts pass, 12/56/688 at m=1/2/4, including independently partial source/target twist layers. Prefix/suffix identities, unitary gates, source restoration and Toeplitz endpoints pass.
- Six semantic rejection controls and the exact sharp Gram-eigenvector/dirty-inverse control pass. Explicit checks remain enabled under optimization.
- Both registered warning-strict commands and the package runner pass locally. Direct normal and optimized checks each took 1.47 s; registered replay took 3.14 s. These are verification durations. Both commands have 240-second caps.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes at head `062ff35225ed38ec601198df1a5c0dcdd7f4424a`, covering all five package files and canonical base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`.
- Official committed export and bundle integrity pass. Optimized Git-free replay with empty PATH passes in 1.47 s and exactly matches the local source-bound receipt.
- Syntax, warning-strict execution and staged whitespace checks pass. Longest function is 35 lines. Finite domains and managed-runtime allocation limits are documented.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/fft-dirty-shear-cuts/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/fft-dirty-shear-cuts/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fft-dirty-shear-cuts
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/fft-dirty-shear-cuts --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 executable may replace the local path. Expected markers are PASS_FFT_DIRTY_SHEAR_CUTS, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Generated stdout receipts bind all five package sources; no receipt is handwritten or committed.

## Limitations

The all-dimension claim rests on the written proof, with finite corroboration. Exact unitary coefficient gates and the specified dependent-layer order are hypotheses; arbitrary subsets within a matching layer are allowed. Rounded roots/data, time inside an atomic gate, all-depth caller composition, generator recursion, fixed-tape costs and complete multiplication remain unrun obligations. The stored-unitary corollary inherits its predecessor's coefficient bounds; its rounded allocation was not audited or changed. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Compose this local bound with one literal triangular caller, retaining ancestor/sibling factors and its physical cut order.
2. Price rounded butterflies and twists using the proved local prefix/suffix envelope, including dirty-source restoration.

Both require separate caller/error ledgers; neither is supplied here.

This account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-22 21:10:34 UTC were refreshed before DONE. Related #4824 and #4827 were already listed; #4828 and #4831 have been read and added above. The other new account contributions study address-algebra kernels, connector or projector tariffs, partial-channel rank or integer job splitting, without computing this Toeplitz gate-cut norm.

All registered local checks, committed-byte/source-history preflight and isolated export replay also pass. No check was left solely to CI; no CI failure was observed or diagnosed. These are scoped automated package checks, not independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the all-dimension theorem.
